description: Return the prompt text for a specific CodeCartographer phase, even if it is not the next eligible phase. Used to revisit a phase or to bypass DAG order intentionally.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the target repository.

phase.description: Phase id from the active pipeline.

unattended.description: As for codecarto_next: no user is in the loop, so interactive hooks default and record their choice instead of asking.
